documents.name: Read People Like a Book
documents.title: Read People Like a Book
documents.author: Patrick King
documents.contentData:
# Chapter 1: How to Analyze People

Speed-reading people, deciphering body language, detecting lies, and understanding human psychology.

Observing body language is akin to learning a second silent language. When you know what to look for, every micro-expression, posture shift, and voice tone reveals a wealth of unsaid feelings.

documents.name: The Power of Your Subconscious Mind
documents.title: The Power of Your Subconscious Mind
documents.author: Joseph Murphy
documents.contentData:
# The Treasure House Within You

Infinite riches are all around you if you will open your mental eyes and behold the treasure house of infinity within you.

There is a gold mine within you from which you can extract everything you need to live life gloriously, joyously, and abundantly.

documents.name: The Body Keeps the Score
documents.title: The Body Keeps the Score
documents.author: Bessel van der Kolk, M.D.
documents.contentData:
# Part 1: The Rediscovery of Trauma

Brain, mind, and body in the healing of trauma.

Trauma is not just an event that took place somewhere in the past; it is also the footprint left by that experience on mind, brain, and body.

documents.author: Virginia Woolf
documents.contentData:
# Section 1: The Window

"Yes, of course, if it's fine tomorrow," said Mrs. Ramsay. "But you'll have to be up with the lark," she added.

To the little boy sitting on the floor, her words conveyed extraordinary joy.
